verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships a built-in AI agent, Fibi, that automatically resolves customer issues. The team can train it through the Training Data API, and the product also offers AI-driven feedback decluttering and AI search answers. This means support work can be handed to built-in AI. However, Fibi is a customer-facing support bot, not an assistant that operators can give arbitrary in-product tasks to. Missing for 10: an operator-facing assistant that takes delegated tasks (e.g., triaging posts, drafting changelogs, editing articles on command), detail on what actions the agent can take, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
